target: m1_data (data/lexicon/drugs.csv all 34 rows; data/templates/*.yaml all 10 files)

findings.item: templates a3, e8, h2, h3, i5 (child encounters) + m1_data/lexicon.py mg_doses
findings.problem: Child-encounter templates render ADULT doses: paracetamol only as 1000 mg or 2 tablets (range 1000-1000) up to 4 times a day, ibuprofen 400 mg. Gold labels treat this as correct, and m4 C4 passes it with an adult range.
findings.suggested_fix: Use dose: none in child templates, or add paediatric liquid forms (ml with mg/5 ml strength) plus an age band; never sample adult mg_doses for a child.
findings.evidence: NHS: children's doses depend on age/weight; 120 mg/5 ml and 250 mg/5 ml liquids; 500 mg tablets only from age 10. US OTC label used by builder: 'children under 12 years: ask a doctor'.

findings.problem: A normal 500 or 650 mg dose (NLEM strengths) is out of range; 3000 mg is a US OTC consumer limit, so a gold 1000 mg x 4/day regimen is flagged.
findings.evidence: NHS adults: one dose is 1 or 2 x 500 mg tablets, at least 4 h apart, no more than 8 in 24 h.

findings.problem: The NLEM 4 mg strength is out of range; the generator falls back to 8 mg.
findings.suggested_fix: adult_dose_range_mg=4-24 (16/24 mg are specialist single-dose regimens)
findings.evidence: US label: tablets 4, 8, 16, 24 mg; 4 mg doses listed; single 24 mg dose before chemotherapy.

findings.problem: The NLEM 1000 mg strength is flagged as out of range.
findings.evidence: US label: tablets 500/850/1000 mg; max 2550 mg/day in divided doses. NHS: taken 1 to 3 times a day. 1000 mg per dose is derived, not quoted.

findings.problem: The 200 mg strength (NLEM, OTC) is out of range.
findings.evidence: OTC label: 200 mg, 1 tablet (2 if needed) every 4-6 h, max 6 in 24 h. Rx label: 400 mg q4-6h, do not exceed 3200 mg/day.

findings.problem: The NLEM 200 mg strength is below the lower bound and is flagged.
findings.suggested_fix: adult_dose_range_mg=200-2000 (UNVERIFIED: the 200 mg strength comes from the builder's NLEM extraction, not re-fetched)
findings.evidence: Lexicon strengths_mg=200|400 versus range 250-2000 in the same row.

findings.problem: A single 400 mg SMX tablet (NLEM strength) is flagged.
findings.evidence: Builder's label note: 1 DS tablet or 2 SS tablets q12h; strengths 400|800.

findings.problem: Under m4 fail-closed, every dosed gold mention of these 12 drugs is flagged, which confounds verifier precision.
findings.suggested_fix: A human fills each range from a fetched label or the National Formulary of India; no values are suggested here.

findings.item: units/strengths: drug-21 ORS, drug-22 zinc, drug-34 iron-folic acid, drug-02/08 combinations
findings.problem: ORS has no unit (it should be sachet or ml, not mg); zinc is a paediatric 10-14 day product, so an adult range does not fit; IFA has no per-component strengths (mg iron + mcg folic acid, an mg/mcg confusion risk); combinations store only one component, so '625 mg' cannot match.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a unit/form column (sachet/ml for ORS); a population column for zinc; per-component strengths for IFA; total-strength aliases (625) for amoxicillin-clavulanate.
findings.evidence: WHO: diarrhoea treated with ORS; 10-14 day course of dispersible zinc tablets.

findings.problem: 'levo' in Indian speech often means levocetirizine (not in the lexicon), so this mapping risks a wrong-drug record.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the 'levo' short forms; review metro/dexa/diclo/amlo the same way.
findings.evidence: AI clinical judgement only (UNVERIFIED; no source fetched).

findings.item: template e2 ('can I take both together?' -> 'yes')
findings.problem: The pharmacist says 'yes' for random pairs, which can include ciprofloxacin/levofloxacin/doxycycline with zinc or iron-folic acid (chelation), or two NSAIDs.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude chelating and same-class pairs from e2, or remove the 'yes' answer.
findings.evidence: Ciprofloxacin label: administer at least 2 h before or 6 h after products containing calcium, iron or zinc.

findings.item: D-62 gold convention: stopped early = negated:true (templates c1-c5)
findings.problem: Partial intake is recorded the same way as never taken; a reader may assume no antibiotic exposure.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an adherence field (taken / partially_taken / not_taken) in record.v2; until then document the limitation.

findings.problem: E4 falls back to random drugs; clinically important pairs (dexamethasone<->prednisolone, diclofenac<->ibuprofen) are missing; the builder's ISMP pairs could not be re-verified.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the within-lexicon pairs (AI-proposed, UNVERIFIED); a human checks the ISMP list.
findings.evidence: drugs.csv confusable_with column; the ISMP PDF fetch was unreadable.

findings.problem: NLEM 2022 membership not confirmed; all NLEM PDF fetches failed in this session.
findings.suggested_fix: A human checks the NLEM 2022 PDF (ORS, amlodipine and omeprazole are believed listed, UNVERIFIED).

findings.item: drug-03 azithromycin range 250-2000, drug-06 doxycycline 100-300, max_daily blank
findings.problem: The upper bounds are single-dose regimens; repeated daily they are an overdose that C4 cannot see.
findings.suggested_fix: Add max_daily_mg (values UNVERIFIED; take them from the label).
findings.evidence: Builder label notes: single 1 g/2 g azithromycin; 300 mg single-visit doxycycline.

findings.item: template g7 ceftriaxone, all strengths as a 5-day daily course; e1/i2 'finish all tablets' on as-needed drugs; g5/i5 'only if fever' with a fixed frequency
findings.problem: Clinically odd combinations (250 mg/day ceftriaxone for an adult; 'finish the course' for paracetamol; an as-needed dose stored as a fixed frequency).
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict ceftriaxone to 1000/2000 mg in g7; restrict 'finish' advice to antibiotics; note that as-needed instructions are not representable.

findings.problem: All 18 match the WHO portal, but the portal shows no edition year.
findings.suggested_fix: A human confirms against the WHO AWaRe 2023/2025 classification file.
findings.evidence: Portal: amoxicillin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, doxycycline, metronidazole, SMX-TMP, cefalexin, nitrofurantoin, cefadroxil, clindamycin, cefazolin = Access; azithromycin, cefixime, ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone, clarithromycin, cefuroxime, levofloxacin, erythromycin = Watch.

summary: SIMULATED clinical review (not clinical validation). AWaRe classes are all correct. Critical: child-encounter templates use adult paracetamol/ibuprofen doses. Major: US-label ranges flag normal Indian doses (paracetamol 500-1000/max 4000, ondansetron 4-24, metformin 500-1000, ibuprofen 200-800, metronidazole 200-2000, cotrimoxazole 400-800); 12 blank ranges; ORS/zinc/IFA unit gaps; 'levo' alias; e2 'take together' with chelating pairs; D-62 adherence; confusable gaps. NLEM and ISMP were not re-verified (fetches failed).
label: ai_simulated_review
